name: YTO Express Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: YTO Express Group Co.,Ltd. provides express delivery services to franchisees in China and internationally. It operates through Express Business, Freight Forwarding Business, and Aviation Business segments. The company offers express services; warehousing and supply chain services, such as transfer services, warehousing system, and integrated warehousing and delivery; industry solutions, including platform and scene solutions; value added services comprising front, terminal, and full chain services.
